description: Semantic Ground Truth App (Bundle 2, ground-truth-app) — build Phases C-J on top of the deployed AppKit scaffold. Edit-only sessions; no Node toolchain in sessions; typecheck/deploy happen later from the interactive controller session.

waves.name: Contracts and server foundation
gate: All wave 0 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
shared/contracts/ contains values.ts, entities.ts, review.ts, api.ts, mcp.ts, errors.ts, index.ts
No file under shared/ contains the keyword 'enum ' or 'namespace '
shared/contracts/mcp.ts defines exactly 12 tool names and every one starts with review_, campaign_ or metric_view_
tsconfig.client.json include list contains shared/contracts
server/lib/ contains db.ts, errors.ts, http.ts, context.ts, config.ts, events.ts, databricks.ts, logger.ts, deps.ts, index.ts
package.json parses as JSON and its dependencies include @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @tanstack/react-query and framer-motion
No file under server/lib/ has a non-type import from 'express'

sessions.title: Shared domain contracts
sessions.scope: Create shared/contracts/ (values, entities, review, api DTOs + zod schemas, MCP tool shapes, error codes, index) and add shared/contracts to tsconfig.client.json include. Types/schemas only.

sessions.title: Server foundation library + dependencies
sessions.scope: Create server/lib/ (db, errors, http, context, config, events, databricks, logger, deps, index) with the exact signatures in build_conventions.md section 7, and add @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @tanstack/react-query, framer-motion to package.json dependencies. Do not touch pnpm-lock.yaml or server.ts.

waves.name: Data model and cross-cutting server modules
gate: All wave 1 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
server/migrations/ contains runner.ts, types.ts, index.ts and six migration files 001_ through 006_
No migration SQL contains a DROP statement and every CREATE TABLE / CREATE INDEX uses IF NOT EXISTS
server/middleware/index.ts exports registerMiddleware
server/services/asset/assetRegistry.ts exports class AssetRegistry and server/services/metricView/metricViewService.ts exports class MetricViewService
server/seed/seed.ts exports seedSampleAssets
Every relative import in files changed this wave resolves to an existing file

sessions.title: Lakebase migrations
sessions.scope: Create server/migrations/ with a custom idempotent runner (runMigrations(db)) and migrations 001-006 for schema app per L200-C1/C5/C7 plus build_conventions.md section 5 additions. Do not wire into server.ts.

sessions.title: Auth and middleware
sessions.scope: Create server/middleware/ (identity from x-forwarded-* headers, roles, request log, otel attributes, locals typing, registerMiddleware). No runtime imports from express or @opentelemetry.

sessions.title: Asset registry, metric view reader, dev seed
sessions.scope: Implement AssetRegistry (server/services/asset/), MetricViewService over the SQL Statement API with the user's OBO token (server/services/metricView/), and an idempotent dev seed of 12 sample assets (server/seed/).

waves.name: Domain services
gate: All wave 2 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
server/services/review/ exports wilsonLowerBound, computeConfidence, deriveStatus, surfacingWeight, pickWeighted and class ReviewEngine
server/services/review/wilsonScore.test.ts expects wilsonLowerBound(10,10,1.96) approximately 0.7225 and wilsonLowerBound(5,10,1.96) approximately 0.2366
server/services/campaign/campaignManager.ts exports class CampaignManager and only uses campaign_type values automatic, manual, freshness
server/services/notification/notificationService.ts exports class NotificationService
No service in server/services/campaign or server/services/notification imports from server/services/review (and vice versa)
Every relative import in files changed this wave resolves to an existing file

sessions.title: Review Engine
sessions.scope: Implement server/services/review/: pure Wilson score + prior, surfacing, gamification, validation query builder (with vitest tests), and ReviewEngine (getNext, submitVote, recompute, stats, leaderboard, executive summary, runQuery).

sessions.title: Campaign Manager
sessions.scope: Implement server/services/campaign/: CampaignManager (create/list/get/updateStatus, scope materialisation, RBAC visibility with fail-open, automatic + freshness campaigns, completion checks, event subscriptions) plus pure lifecycle/scope helpers and tests.

sessions.title: Notification Service
sessions.scope: Implement server/services/notification/: NotificationService (in-app inbox, preferences, digest, event subscriptions) and Slack/Teams/webhook destinations that are inactive unless their env vars are set. No app.yaml or resources changes.

waves.name: HTTP surface and client API layer
gate: All wave 3 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
server/routes/lakebase/todo-routes.ts no longer exists and no file under server/ references todo-routes or setupSampleLakebaseRoutes
server/server.ts calls runMigrations, createServices, registerMiddleware, registerRoutes and mountMcp
server/routes/health.ts registers GET /health
server/mcp/index.ts exports mountMcp
server/services/index.ts exports createServices and getServices
Every route path in the route table of docs/plans/09_rest_routes_wiring.md appears in server/routes/, and every non-health route path appears in client/src/lib/api/endpoints.ts
Every relative import in server/server.ts, server/routes/** and client/src/lib/api/** resolves to an existing file

sessions.title: REST routes and composition root
sessions.scope: Implement every row of the plan 09 route table in server/routes/, createServices/getServices in server/services/index.ts, a stub mountMcp in server/mcp/index.ts, and rewrite server/server.ts startup (migrations, services, seed, middleware, routes, MCP, timers). Delete the sample todo routes.

sessions.title: Client API layer
sessions.scope: Create client/src/lib/api/: typed fetch client, query keys, endpoint functions and React Query v5 hooks for every non-health row of the plan 09 route table, QueryClient factory and role helper.

waves.name: Interfaces: MCP, UI, agents
gate: All wave 4 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
server/mcp/index.ts no longer contains the 503 stub and registers POST /mcp
Every name in MCP_TOOL_NAMES is registered in server/mcp/tools/
client/src/App.tsx routes /, /leaderboard, /steward, /admin, /executive, /assistant and does not import AnalyticsPage, LakebasePage or JobsPage
client/src/pages/{leaderboard,steward,admin,executive}/ export LeaderboardPage, StewardPage, AdminPage, ExecutivePage
Exactly one server/agents/*/agent.md has default: true; server/agents/planner and server/agents/helper no longer exist; server/agents/skills/tracer-bullets is unchanged
No file under client/src/components/ or client/src/pages/ (excluding client/src/pages/agents/) calls fetch directly
Every relative import in files changed this wave resolves to an existing file

sessions.title: MCP server at /mcp
sessions.scope: Replace the stub server/mcp/index.ts with a stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server registering exactly the 12 MCP_TOOL_NAMES tools, per-user session state, markdown + HTML card views and tool error mapping. Do not edit server.ts.

sessions.title: App shell and card-swipe review experience
sessions.scope: Rewrite client/src/App.tsx and main.tsx (router, layout, React Query provider), build client/src/components/layout/ and client/src/components/review/ and the ReviewPage at /. Route secondary pages to session 13's fixed paths and /assistant to the existing AgentChat.

sessions.title: Leaderboard, steward, admin, executive pages
sessions.scope: Build LeaderboardPage, StewardPage, AdminPage, ExecutivePage (named exports at the plan's fixed paths) and their components using the client/src/lib/api hooks.

sessions.title: Ground Truth agents
sessions.scope: Replace the sample planner/helper agents with review-assistant (markdown, default) and review-worker (code, read-only tools via getServices), and add review-guide and scoring-model skills. Keep tracer-bullets.

waves.name: Tests, cleanup, docs
gate: All wave 5 sessions have status done
bundle validate --strict --target dev passes
client/src/pages/analytics, client/src/pages/lakebase and client/src/pages/jobs no longer exist (or session 15 logged a request explaining why)
server/example.test.ts no longer exists and the 7 test files listed in plan 15 exist
README.md links to docs/runbooks/first-deploy-verification.md and the runbook has 12 numbered steps each with an expected result
No relative import anywhere under server/, client/src/ or shared/ points to a file that does not exist

sessions.title: Tests and scaffold cleanup
sessions.scope: Delete the analytics/lakebase/jobs sample pages and server/example.test.ts, update AgentChat.tsx copy only, and add the 7 vitest test files listed in the plan.

sessions.title: App README and first-deploy runbook
sessions.scope: Rewrite README.md for the built app and write docs/runbooks/first-deploy-verification.md (lockfile regeneration, deploy, per-subsystem verification, follow-ups). Documentation only.
